briefing.headline: DFH rockets 28.6% overnight while MTUM plunges 75.8%
briefing.summary: The overnight session showed a mixed picture. Core mega‑cap tech names were mostly down, with AMD and NVDA each slipping over 2% and the QQQ ETF losing 1.1%. Factor ETFs MTUM and QUAL crashed dramatically, while niche tokens such as DFH, GPGI, ENOV, AGL and XMAX posted gains above 20%. Breadth was thin – only four of the ten core stocks advanced versus six decliners – suggesting caution ahead of the US open.
